name: standard-delivery
title: Standard Project Delivery
description: The core delivery tickets TSD creates for every new project: project management ceremonies, infrastructure setup, and go-live launch tasks. Platform-neutral - apply umbraco-setup on top for Umbraco projects, and stripe-integration where the site takes payments.

variables.name: domain_name
variables.description: The project's primary domain name, e.g. example.com

tasks.title: Project Kick-off (internal)
tasks.description: Brief the delivery team: scope, approach, roles, key dates, budget and known risks before any client-facing work starts.

tasks.title: Project Kick-off (client)
tasks.description: Align with the customer on goals, timeline, comms cadence, who signs off what, and how feedback/tickets flow.

tasks.title: Ticket Management
tasks.description: Ongoing triage, refinement and prioritisation of the project's tickets.

tasks.title: DSU / Regular Check-in
tasks.description: Daily stand-up or regular check-in cadence for the project team.

tasks.title: Project Planning
tasks.description: Sprint/iteration planning and roadmap maintenance.

tasks.title: Weekly client status update
tasks.description: Short weekly summary to the customer: progress, what's next, decisions needed, and anything at risk. Keeps surprises out of invoicing conversations.

tasks.title: Budget & burn-rate review
tasks.description: Weekly check of logged time against budget in Productive. Flag early if the burn rate points at an overrun rather than discovering it at invoicing.

tasks.title: Risks, assumptions & dependencies log
tasks.description: Maintain a RAID log: risks, assumptions, issues and dependencies (customer content, third-party access, DNS control etc). Review it at planning sessions.

tasks.title: Show & Tell
tasks.description: Regular demo of progress to the customer.

tasks.title: UAT coordination
tasks.description: Agree the UAT window with the customer, provide a test plan/checklist, and capture their feedback as tickets rather than emails.

tasks.title: Retrospective
tasks.description: End-of-phase retrospective: what went well, what to improve.

tasks.title: Project close-down
tasks.description: Archive the project properly: final invoice check, remove temporary access/test accounts, ensure documentation and credentials are stored, move the project to support/retainer status.

tasks.title: Post-launch review (30 days)
tasks.description: Review the site with the customer a month after launch: analytics and search rankings, Seq errors, outstanding snags, and upsell/next-phase opportunities.

tasks.title: Create Azure blob storage for media (CDN)
General project setup (Rider SLN files etc)
Setup Seq API Keys for UAT
tasks.description: Create a UAT-specific API key in Seq and configure the test environment to log to it. Keys are per environment so noisy UAT logging can be filtered or throttled without touching production.

tasks.title: Setup Seq API Keys for PROD
tasks.description: Create a production API key in Seq and configure the live environment to log to it.

tasks.title: Setup StatusCake monitoring against the test site
tasks.description: Uptime check against the UAT/staging URL so hosting or deployment breakage shows up during the build, not at demo time. Remember UAT is often behind basic auth - allow the StatusCake check through or monitor a public health endpoint.

tasks.title: Setup StatusCake monitoring against the live site
tasks.description: Uptime and SSL certificate checks against https://{{domain_name}} with alerts to the support channel. Set up ahead of go-live so it's watching from the moment DNS switches.

tasks.title: Set up CreateSend mailing list account + API keys
Ensure production licences are in place
tasks.description: Check every licence the live site needs is purchased and installed **for the live domain** before DNS switches - domain-bound licences (e.g. Umbraco Commerce, Umbraco Forms, uSync Complete) that worked on UAT will not cover production. Confirm the licence files/keys are in the production deployment, not just a developer machine.

tasks.title: Update DNS settings
tasks.description: Point {{domain_name}} at the new hosting. Check both WWW and non-WWW variations are set up.

tasks.title: Check HTTP redirects to HTTPS
tasks.description: http://{{domain_name}} must 301 to https://{{domain_name}}. Check a deep URL as well as the homepage, and confirm the certificate is valid for both www and non-www.

tasks.title: Check www redirects to the non-www site
tasks.description: https://www.{{domain_name}} must 301 to https://{{domain_name}} (single canonical hostname). Check a deep URL too - some configs only redirect the root.

tasks.title: Ensure canonical URL redirects are set up
tasks.description: One URL per page: lowercase enforced, trailing slash policy applied consistently, and old/legacy URLs redirecting to their new equivalents. Spot-check with the network tab that a canonical URL loads with **no** redirect and a non-canonical variant reaches it in a **single** 301 hop.

tasks.title: Ensure Google Tag Manager is installed and firing
tasks.description: Confirm the GTM container snippet is on every page template with the correct container ID, and use GTM preview mode against the live site to confirm the container loads and tags fire.

tasks.title: Ensure GA4 is receiving data (via GTM)
tasks.description: Check the GA4 tag fires from GTM (not a hard-coded gtag snippet) with the correct measurement ID, then confirm live traffic appears in GA4's Realtime report. Check internal/TSD IPs are excluded.

tasks.title: Ensure Microsoft Clarity is recording (via GTM)
tasks.description: Check the Clarity tag fires from GTM with the correct project ID and that sessions appear in the Clarity dashboard (recordings can lag a little behind).

tasks.title: Ensure the site is configured in Google Search Console
tasks.description: Verify the property for {{domain_name}} (domain property covers www/non-www and both protocols), submit the XML sitemap, and check for coverage errors once it starts processing.

tasks.title: Ensure StatusCake is configured for the production URL
tasks.description: The uptime and SSL checks must point at https://{{domain_name}} (not the pre-launch/holding URL) with alerts going to the support channel. Confirm a green check after DNS has switched.

tasks.title: Ensure Seq is configured and logging
tasks.description: Confirm production events for {{domain_name}} are arriving in Seq under the PROD API key after go-live, and that errors would alert - trigger a harmless test log entry if nothing has come through naturally.

tasks.title: Put a live test transaction through (e-commerce only)
tasks.description: Place a real low-value order on the live site with a TSD card against the live payment setup: payment appears in the provider's live dashboard, the order status updates via the live webhook, and the confirmation email sends. Then refund it. (This is the live smoke test from the stripe-integration template - skip here if that template is being worked.)
